title: food & music
content: Here's one, Was playing at home with a friend / family. After his fight training , we went out. It was a small external mall with food business choices. We went for the back door to arrive to this fancy / busy music + food place. I was trailing my group and arrived slightly our of time sync. They already ordered food and sat down, For 5min I was walking around to different boots of tge restaurant. Most of tgese boots had their own music + Hollywood stars 😅 Mt group was shouting & foubd them. Sat doen to talk , drink/food didn't work I judt woke up 😂 Before this one, a few months ago I was at this other restaurant with Celine Dion singing. Another one, was meeting my friend Jerry Seinfeld selling food stuff on top of a building, no music. I sense a distinct pattern here... Anyways , sharing the story for now
